summary:
Abandoned But Not Forgotten is an educational website that tells the stories of spacecraft, rovers, landers, and scientific equipment that have completed their missions or stopped communicating.

The website organizes 17 catalog entries into three main categories: The Moon, Mars, and Beyond. It explains the purpose of each mission, its discoveries, and the current status of its equipment.

The project addresses the lack of attention given to inactive space missions by collecting their stories in one accessible platform. It aims to preserve space exploration history, recognize scientific achievements, and make technical information easier for everyone to understand.

The website includes several features:

    Explore: Browse missions by destination.

    Discover: Read individual mission stories.

    Search and Filter: Find specific spacecraft and missions.

    Timeline: Explore important events chronologically.

    Quiz: Test knowledge through interactive questions.

    Language Switching: Access the website in English or Arabic.

    Responsive Design: Use the website on computers, tablets, and mobile phones.

The target audience includes students, teachers, space enthusiasts, and anyone interested in science and technology.

Expected Outcome:

The final result will be a bilingual, responsive, and interactive educational website that highlights forgotten space missions and their contributions to science.
